Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 21,900+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded 23M+ times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

  • Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post with your name on it.   • Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

  • Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

  • Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

  • Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

  • Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

Learn more about our infrastructure

  • From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution — deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges

  • Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

These are growth paths, not fully-formed PM seats. Our legacy stack involves over 100 systems across the globe including proprietary invoicing/billing/scheduling systems, two Salesforce instances and NetSuite, among others. Our new stack is HubSpot, Metronome, Stripe, NetSuite, and Workato. Getting from one to the other — while the business keeps running on both — is the core challenge of both tracks. We're hiring two people into this role. The skills profile is similar for both, but each hire will own one of two distinct tracks: O2C Integrations or CRM Projects . These tracks will eventually mature into a larger scope of internal tooling and enterprise customization. Track assignment will be based on candidate strengths and interest during onboarding, rather than decided in advance. Set integration ecosystem strategy — Define how integrations across business systems should be architected as a whole: point-to-point vs. centralized (e.g., via Workato), reusable patterns, and standards for how new systems connect in. Bridge legacy and new-stack engineering teams — Be the technical point of contact ensuring O2C data contracts and dependencies are understood on both sides. Lead the Salesforce STAR sunset project — Same ownership model, applied to the STAR instance. Control the HubSpot vendor relationship — Own vendor management for HubSpot, including contract terms, SLA performance, and roadmap alignment with vendor capabilities. Own marketing automations — Own the roadmap and execution for marketing automation workflows (built largely on HubSpot). Campaign strategy sits with Marketing; you own the tooling and execution layer those campaigns run on. Manage sunset risk — Identify what breaks if a legacy system goes away too early, and build technically sound mitigation and rollback plans. What We're Looking For Software engineering background — you've built, maintained, or integrated production systems, ideally including APIs, middleware, or data pipelines. Strong communication skills — able to explain technical tradeoffs to engineers, vendors, and business stakeholders alike. Detail oriented and structured approach — planning and running complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects to completion, including sequencing, risk management, and timeline ownership. Comfortable reading and reasoning about system architecture and data models across multiple connected systems without translation from engineering. Interesse an Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle und zeitgenössischer visueller Kultur. Gutes Verständnis aktueller Social-Media- und Design-Trends. Sicherheit im Einbringen eigener Ideen und im Nachfragen. Flexibilität und eine Hands-on-Mentalität. title: AI Video Creator & Editor
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Video Creator & Editor based in Germany. This role combines AI video generation and hands-on editing to create high-performing direct-response advertising for Meta and TikTok. You will own creatives end to end, from interpreting briefs and generating AI footage to editing polished, launch-ready ads. The position focuses on UGC-style talking-head content, product scenes, b-roll, hooks, variations, and conversion-driven storytelling. You will work closely with Creative Strategists and the Paid Social team to turn concepts and performance insights into compelling new assets. Success means consistently delivering high-quality, on-brief creatives at volume while keeping revisions low and continuously improving what performs. You will join a growing remote video team and have access to AI tools, established workflows, and real campaign environments in which to develop your skills. The role is fully remote, full-time, and follows UK working hours. Accountabilities Generate AI video assets for Meta and TikTok advertising, including UGC-style talking-head clips, product scenes, b-roll, and complete concept videos. Develop and refine prompts, reference images, and generation settings while maintaining a reusable library of effective prompts and workflows. Edit high-volume direct-response ads by combining AI-generated footage with scripts, raw footage, UGC, and approved product assets. Create compelling first-second hooks, rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, product demonstrations, offers, and clear calls to action. Produce multiple variations of successful concepts by testing different hooks, scenes, characters, openings, pacing, and visual treatments. Maintain visual consistency across characters, products, and brand assets while quality-checking generated content for realistic motion, readable text, accurate product representation, and other AI-generation issues. Add motion graphics using After Effects or an equivalent tool and ensure creatives meet platform and brand requirements. Collaborate closely with Creative Strategists to execute briefs accurately, respond quickly to feedback, and contribute new angles, hooks, and formats suited to AI generation. Keep project files, assets, and feedback organized using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar collaboration and asset-management tools. Stay current with evolving AI video models and creative technologies, testing new tools and incorporating effective workflows into production. Maintain reliable turnaround times and a high-quality output while contributing to creative testing, learning, and scalable advertising concepts. Requirements: Bring 1–3 years of experience in creative or video production, including e-commerce or direct-response paid-social editing, with a portfolio demonstrating both self-edited conversion-focused ads and AI-generated video work. Have hands-on experience with AI video-generation tools such as Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Sora, Runway, or similar platforms, with strong prompting and iteration skills. Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut, together with After Effects or equivalent motion-graphics capabilities. Be comfortable using Google Drive, Frame.io, or similar tools for organized asset management, collaboration, and feedback. Understand hook-first, direct-response editing for Meta and TikTok, including rapid pacing, subtitles, pattern interrupts, visual proof, product demonstrations, offers, CTAs, and testable creative variations. Have a strong visual eye and the ability to distinguish AI-generated footage that feels authentic from content that appears artificial or unrealistic. Be able to maintain high output without sacrificing quality, respond quickly to feedback, and work accurately under pressure. Demonstrate creativity, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and a thoughtful, methodical approach to production. Have strong written and spoken English, proactive communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a remote creative team. Be available for a full-time, exclusive commitment without other clients or freelance work alongside the role. Experience with AI image-generation tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, or Flux, AI voice tools such as ElevenLabs, winning or scaled advertising campaigns, visually driven DTC categories, motion design, compositing, 3D, VFX, or sound design is considered a plus. Benefits: Competitive compensation discussed individually based on experience and location. Fully remote, full-time work following UK working hours. Access to AI video-generation tools and approved creative workflows. Opportunities to develop AI generation and video-editing skills through real advertising campaigns. Regular structured meetings and scheduled feedback sessions with the creative team. The opportunity to join a new ten-person video team operating in a high-volume creative testing environment. Room for professional growth as AI models, creative workflows, and production capabilities continue to evolve. title: AI Analytics Account Executive
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Analytics Account Executive based in Germany. This is a strategic sales role focused on accelerating growth across analytics, AI, and modern data platform solutions. You will partner closely with enterprise Account Executives to identify opportunities, advance complex deals, and expand customer relationships. The role combines deep expertise in analytics and AI with hands-on enterprise sales execution and consultative selling. You will create new pipeline within existing accounts while helping sales teams position solutions around customer business priorities. As a specialist overlay, you will influence multiple accounts and stakeholders while bringing strong domain expertise to the wider sales organisation. You will engage senior technology and business leaders, navigate complex buying processes, and help customers modernize their data environments. This is an opportunity to play a visible role in expanding adoption of data and AI technologies within a collaborative, high-performance EMEA sales environment. Accountabilities Partner with Account Executives and territory owners to accelerate active enterprise opportunities involving analytics, AI, data platforms, and related solutions. Co-sell on complex opportunities, providing specialist domain expertise, customer insights, value propositions, and sales support throughout the deal cycle. Design and execute targeted sales campaigns within existing customer accounts to uncover new analytics and AI opportunities and expand the commercial footprint. Generate new pipeline proactively rather than relying solely on inbound opportunities. Identify customer needs and connect analytics, AI, data modernization, cloud, and platform capabilities to measurable business outcomes. Serve as a subject matter expert for the broader sales organisation, providing current analytics messaging, competitive positioning, industry insights, and value propositions. Enable Account Executives and other field teams to confidently position analytics and AI solutions with enterprise customers. Work closely with account owners to integrate specialist solutions into broader account plans and territory strategies. Engage credibly with senior technology and business executives, helping them understand the strategic and commercial value of modern data and AI capabilities. Lead discovery, qualification, negotiation, forecasting, and closing activities for opportunities within your specialist area. title: Maintenance Supervisor (m/f/d)
description: <h2><strong>In a nutshell</strong></h2> <p>As a Maintenance Supervisor (m/f/d), you will work in our new Fulfilment Center in the Berlin/Brandenburg area (Falkensee), working with highly automated intralogistics systems from leading brands such as Apollo, Qimarox and Regal Rexnord. You will take operational responsibility for maintenance during your shift and lead our team of Maintenance Technicians.</p> <p>You set priorities, ensure safe and structured ways of working and act as the key link between Maintenance and Operations. When critical breakdowns occur, you take the lead and work with your team to get our systems back up and running quickly.</p> <p>Your leadership skills, technical understanding and hands-on mindset will help us keep our operation running smoothly and ensure that around 10,000 orders reach our customers on time every day.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/50pQKpPc24E" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead &amp; develop your team:</strong> You lead the Maintenance Technicians during your shift, coach them on the job and support their development.</li> <li><strong>Own the shift:</strong> You set priorities, coordinate maintenance activities and ensure high-quality work and equipment availability.</li> <li><strong>Manage critical breakdowns:</strong> You coordinate your team during technical issues and work closely with Operations to minimize downtime.</li> <li><strong>Drive safety &amp; structure:</strong> You ensure that safety standards are followed and that maintenance work is carried out in a clean and structured environment.</li> <li><strong>Drive continuous improvement:</strong> You identify improvement opportunities and implement Lean, 5S and Continuous Improvement initiatives together with your team.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across teams:</strong> You work closely with Operations, Maintenance Engineers and external maintenance partners.</li> <li><strong>Competitive salary with growth potential:</strong> Starting at €70,000 gross/year, with annual performance reviews designed to drive your personal and financial development.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have a completed technical qualification with further training as a Technician or Master Craftsman, or a completed technical degree (Bachelor/Master), for example in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field</li> <li>You have 10+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance environment, ideally within an automated, logistics or production environment</li> <li>You have at least 3 years of leadership experience, for example as a Team Lead, Lead Technician, Supervisor or in a comparable role</li> <li>You have a hands-on mindset and understand both the technical and operational side of maintenance</li> <li>You have experience with Lean, 5S and Continuous Improvement and enjoy applying these principles on the shop floor</li> <li>You work in a structured way, take ownership and stay calm and focused during critical breakdowns</li> <li>You are fluent in both English (German is strong plus)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you can look forward to</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Smart Commute: </strong>Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program.</li> <li><strong>Time to recharge:</strong> With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure.</li> <li><strong>Fuel for Winners:</strong> Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled.</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career:</strong> Join our international team in an environment that fosters real growth and an “Act like an Owner” mentality. Here, you’ll have the chance to drive projects independently, test new ideas, and level up through specialized trainings to see firsthand how your work makes an impact.</li> <li><strong>Sustainability at Core:</strong> Be part of the revolution. You’ll contribute to a greener future through our 100% electric fleet and a business model designed to drastically reduce food waste.</li> <li><strong>The Essentials:</strong> We provide the tools for success, including a laptop and phone, and access to exclusive Corporate Benefits discounts for travel, tech and more.</li> <li><strong>Unforgettable Moments:</strong> From our legendary annual ski trip, our massive Christmas parties, to parties featuring our very own Picnic band, we make sure our milestones are celebrated in style.</li> <li><strong>Well-being &amp; Balance:&nbsp;</strong>Professional mental health support via OpenUp.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei - durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. raw.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

It’s demanding – but always rewarding.</p> <p>This is meaningful work with real-world impact – the kind you can point to with pride.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>As a&nbsp;Search Manager, you will own the day-to-day execution of all elements of paid search and paid social activity, leveraging strong platform knowledge and supplier relationships to deliver flawless testing, media plans, optimization, and analysis. You will act as a key point of contact for colleagues supporting campaign delivery, proactively seeking both tactical and strategic optimization opportunities, contributing to campaign strategy and translating it into effective delivery within the WPP Open ecosystem.</p> <p><strong>Operating Model &amp; Ways of Working</strong></p> <p>The NMU is designed to deliver a highly agile and responsive service, operating across three defined speeds of delivery:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Always‑on activity</strong><br>Continuous delivery, optimisation and performance management</li> <li><strong>Tactical activity</strong><br>End‑to‑end delivery (brief, creative, booking, live) within approximately two weeks</li> <li><strong>Reactive activity</strong><br>24‑hour turnaround, from brief to creative development and live execution, responding to policy updates, announcements or external events</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Line Management:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Manage one or several team members, overseeing their work and development to successfully execute client deliverables. Provide coaching and support, ensuring workloads are effectively managed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Campaign Management:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the day-to-day execution and effective management of designated paid search and paid social accounts, ensuring ongoing and timely optimization and proactively identifying tactical and strategic opportunities and forecasting.</li> <li>Develop comprehensive biddable media plans (+ supporting material) aligned with client objectives and KPIs, clearly articulating the rationale for proposed tactics.</li> <li>Responsible for end-to-end setup of biddable campaigns across relevant platforms, utilizing advanced features (e.g., bid rules, 3rd party tools).</li> <li>Oversee and ensure regular Quality Assurance (QA) checks, monitoring campaign performance, pacing, troubleshooting, and optimizing to improve performance.</li> <li>Produce detailed and accurate weekly/monthly campaign performance reports and insightful commentary, including end-of-campaign reporting and quarterly/annual reviews.</li> <li>Identify trends and recommend on-platform actions to capitalize/mitigate these trends.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client &amp; Partner Management:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop strong relationships with colleagues supporting campaign delivery, your client, and key suppliers, leading team communications and building rapport to become a trusted advisor.</li> <li>Act as a key biddable point-of-contact for clients, ensuring confidence in the team's output and supporting client calls/presentations.</li> <li>Demonstrate strong knowledge of the client sector/industry and media/technology developments, identifying strategic issues and opportunities to test and innovate in the biddable space.</li> </ul> <p><strong>People the immediate and wider team when required, attending interviews and acting as an ambassador.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Make full use of technology, implementing processes that maximize operational efficiencies and identify opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Take ownership of issues when they arise, proactively suggesting resolutions and preventative measures.</li> <li>Contribute to the development of strategic revenue and services opportunities.</li> <li>Ensure financial accuracy, integrating the planning and buying process, and reconciliation of spends, including client terms and fees.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with planning teams and other channel specialists to ensure biddable activity complements and enhances the wider marketing mix.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Biddable Expertise:</strong>&nbsp;Proven experience in both Paid Search (Google Ads, Bing Ads) and Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest etc.), with current certifications (Google and Microsoft Ads, Meta Blueprint desirable).</li> <li><strong>Leadership &amp; Innovation:</strong>&nbsp;Leads and promotes continuous innovation, and test &amp; learn opportunities for the team and clients. Creates a positive climate to drive team performance whilst motivating others.</li> <li><strong>Analytical &amp; Strategic:</strong>&nbsp;Excellent knowledge of bid management, core PPC/social technology platforms, and data analysis. Strong analytical skills with an aptitude for handling data to identify trends and actionable insights. Ability to devise campaign strategy and translate it into effective delivery.</li> <li><strong>People Management:</strong>&nbsp;Proven experience managing individuals, overseeing their work and development, and motivating team members.</li> <li><strong>Client &amp; Partner Management:</strong>&nbsp;Strong relationship-building skills with clients, colleagues supporting campaign delivery, and key suppliers; ability to foster good working relationships across client teams.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong>&nbsp;Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with people from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and countries, including translating technical points to non-technical audiences.</li> <li><strong>Mindset:</strong>&nbsp;Passionate about Biddable media, leading by example, and driving continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p data-section-id="1wdkf9o" data-start="1250" data-end="1267">Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands</p> <h2 data-section-id="1wdkf9o" data-start="1250" data-end="1267">About the team</h2> <p data-start="1269" data-end="1487">Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&amp;D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.</p> <p data-start="1489" data-end="1741">AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&amp;D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.</p> <p data-start="1743" data-end="1817">The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.</p> <h2 data-section-id="1wdgaw5" data-start="1846" data-end="1863">About the role</h2> <p data-start="1865" data-end="1976">We're looking for an <strong data-start="1886" data-end="1908">AI Product Operations Lead</strong> to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&amp;D.</p> <p data-start="1978" data-end="2318">This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. description: Do you want to build the AI systems that compliance teams rely on to investigate real financial crime? Are you excited about taking agentic workflows from prototype to production at scale? Do you want your work to directly help catch bad actors moving money across blockchains? Elliptic is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI team. It is the team behind Elliptic's copilot, the AI product that helps compliance investigators trace fund flows, surface patterns, and respond to risk in real time. This role sits at the centre of that work, designing the agentic systems, LLM integrations, and backend services that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers. You'll join a focused team that cares about the quality of what it builds and gives you the space to do your best work. There's real ownership here, breadth across AI and backend systems, and the freedom to turn good ideas into shipped products. The problems are technically challenging, and the work is visible. The impact you will have: As a Senior AI Engineer on the AI team, you'll own significant parts of the Agentic stack that power Elliptic's copilot. You'll lead the design of agentic workflows, drive technical decisions on how we build and operate LLM-based features, and help raise the engineering standard across the team. You'll partner with product, web engineers, and your engineering lead to take complex problems from ambiguity to shipped product, and you'll mentor more junior engineers as the team grows. What you will do: Design and build agentic workflows and AI-powered features that power Elliptic's copilot, using LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. Lead the design of agents, tool integrations, and retrieval pipelines that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers for investigators. Build and own evaluation frameworks that measure and improve the quality, reliability, and latency of LLM outputs. Design and build the backend services, APIs, and event-driven systems that support these features, using TypeScript and Node.js. Drive technical design reviews and architecture decisions for AI workstreams. Mentor and coach more junior engineers through pair programming, code review, and design feedback. Raise the engineering bar across the team by promoting good practices in testing, observability, and AI system reliability. Influence cross-team decisions on how AI capabilities integrate with the rest of the Elliptic platform. What you will achieve in the first 6 months: Owned and shipped at least one significant AI capability end-to-end, from ambiguous problem statement through to production. Driven the technical direction of an AI workstream, including architecture, evaluation, and rollout. Established or improved at least one team practice for building AI systems (evals, observability patterns, prompt management, rollout safety). Mentored junior engineers on AI engineering practices and contributed to their growth. Built strong working relationships across product, web engineering, data engineering, and DevOps. Started to influence adjacent teams on how Elliptic builds with AI. You will be a great fit here if you: Care about building AI systems that work reliably in production, not just demos. Have strong instincts for trade-offs specific to LLM systems: cost vs latency vs quality, deterministic vs probabilistic behaviour, when to use an agent vs a workflow. Can take ambiguous AI problems and break them into shippable pieces with clear evaluation criteria. Communicate clearly with non-engineers (product, stakeholders, leadership) about AI capabilities and limitations. Have coached or mentored other engineers and enjoy raising the bar through reviews, pairing, and feedback. Are genuinely curious about the domain and find blockchain investigations and financial crime prevention interesting. Our ideal candidate has: 5-8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years of meaningful production work building LLM-powered features. Direct experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar. Hands-on experience building agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, planning, memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, and managing the trade-offs of working with LLMs. Experience building and running evaluations for LLM outputs (eval sets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing). Strong backend skills in TypeScript / Node.js, with solid API design. Cloud experience (AWS: Lambda, ECS, S3, or similar). Database proficiency across SQL (Postgres) and some NoSQL exposure. Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach other engineers. Uses AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) critically and effectively as part of their day-to-day workflow. Bonus points for: Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar). Experience designing multi-agent systems and agent orchestration patterns. Familiarity with LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or similar). Experience working with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-weight models) or with fine-tuning. Hands-on experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code tooling. Experience with observability platforms like Datadog. Distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS). Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, or compliance. title: Head of Data Science
description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 6000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The role: We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production. The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics. We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start. This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance. What you'll do: Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly. Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build. Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them. Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way. Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on. Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions need backdated reconstruction; eval harnesses and trace observability for agentic workflows; and monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance and economic outcomes. Start ad hoc where that's sufficient and platformise once the first use cases have shown what's actually needed. Own value capture end to end. Shadow-test and A/B test every deployment against the incumbent strategy, translate metric movement into a financial number on a methodology co-signed by Finance, and publish a quarterly report on realised value. Set the governance model for automated decisioning — proportionate risk assessment, clear ownership, latency and availability requirements, human escalation and rollback — working with Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Risk on GDPR, EU AI Act and payments obligations, and producing the evidence early enough to shape the design. Define the boundaries and the working relationship with Product Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Platform and AI Enablement, so accountability for decision support versus automated decisioning stays unambiguous. Deliver cross-functionally: embed in delivery groups with product owners, domain experts and platform engineers rather than handing models over the wall. We'd love to hear from you if you: Experienced leading data science or ML teams that own systems in production, with deployments that moved a commercial metric and kept running afterwards. Proofs of concept and dashboards are not what we're hiring for. Hands-on now, not formerly. Your first quarters are spent writing SQL and Python, engineering features, evaluating models and agents, and doing the work that gets a system live — not reviewing someone else's. Experienced across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and clear about how they differ in practice: propensity and uplift models, feature pipelines and drift on one side; tool and context design, prompt and retrieval iteration, evals against golden answer sets and trace observability on the other. Practised at running live systems rather than just launching them — monitoring, retraining, incident response, rollback, and the on-call reality of a decision the business depends on. Pragmatic about method: happy to argue for rules or heuristics where they capture most of the value, and to reserve models and agents for where they genuinely earn their keep. Comfortable with an undefined starting point. There's a long list of candidate use cases and a strong internal hypothesis, but no fixed roadmap — you'll be expected to form your own view, back it with numbers, and defend it to an executive audience. Strong on measurement — experimentation, uplift modelling, back-testing — and willing to hold your own work to a financial number that Finance will scrutinise. Fluent in the engineering side of production ML and agents (training pipelines, model registries, inference services, feature stores, drift detection, trace observability) and able to hold your own with senior engineers on latency, availability, observability and rollback. Able to hire, level and develop senior data scientists and ML engineers, and to set standards for a function that doesn't exist yet. Credible with executives and commercial stakeholders: you can take a use case from business problem to value estimate to prioritisation decision, and say no to low-value work. Experienced in payments, fintech, subscriptions, high-volume commercial operations or another regulated transactional domain — enough to get to a credible value estimate in a new area quickly. Comfortable treating regulated ML as a design constraint rather than paperwork — model risk assessment, DPIAs, auditability, traceability of model and policy versions to production decision logic. This is a focused advisory role. You will test whether proposed technology and operating changes make sense for pensions administration. A typical assignment may involve around two days split between a findings review and review of the final report. Scope and days are agreed separately. Primarily remote within the UK.

Tasks

  • Review findings about pensions administration systems and their connections to other services.
  • Test proposed changes against operational needs, service quality and delivery constraints.
  • Challenge weak assumptions about internal teams, suppliers and transition risks.
  • Help architects distinguish genuine business requirements from platform preferences.
  • Review relevant recommendations and explain any practical concerns clearly.
  • Work with client specialists while respecting their existing pensions knowledge.

Requirements

  • Senior operational, consulting or technology leadership experience in UK pensions administration.
  • Direct knowledge of administration processes, data quality, system interfaces and supplier delivery.
  • Experience reviewing technology or operating changes affecting pensions services.
  • Able to give independent advice without promoting a particular platform or supplier.
  • Confident discussing findings with senior technology and business leaders.
  • Able to disclose and manage relevant conflicts of interest before accepting an assignment.

Benefits

  • £1,000 to £1,500 per day, depending on relevant experience. Rates exclude VAT where applicable. Contracting route and tax status will be confirmed before an assignment is agreed.
  • Short, focused assignments suited to an experienced independent adviser.
  • Direct access to the engagement partner and technical team.
  • Flexible remote working, with any necessary travel agreed in advance.
  • Potential for further assignments by mutual agreement. No minimum volume of work is guaranteed.

Apply with your CV and answer the short screening questions. No cover letter is needed. Shortlisted candidates will discuss relevant assignments, availability and rate with us. We will agree scope, working days and contract terms before work starts. Please do not include confidential client documents.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>As an Applied AI Strategist for EMEA, you will be Anthropic's senior strategic voice with EMEA’s most strategic customers. You'll engage C-suite executives and senior business leaders at Europe's and the Middle East's largest enterprises to understand their challenges, shape their vision for how AI transforms their strategy, and build alignment toward bold, high-impact AI adoption.</p> <p>This is not a hands-on engineering role. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p><strong>This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.&nbsp;</strong></p> <h4>The Opportunity:</h4> <p>At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.</p> <p>The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App.&nbsp;Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API,&nbsp;payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50&nbsp;million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.</p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent&nbsp;across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment.&nbsp;Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our&nbsp;request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products&nbsp;depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or&nbsp;someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of&nbsp;you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one.&nbsp;That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling&nbsp;except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by&nbsp;taking scope and being right about it, fast.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption&nbsp;tracking, and our public TTS API</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it&nbsp;correct after you've moved on</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that&nbsp;freed you up for</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the&nbsp;product is going</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)</li> <li>Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail — what runs unattended,&nbsp;what you review, and where you've decided it doesn't get to act alone</li> <li>The instinct to check a result against the system itself — logs, database state, the actual&nbsp;request — rather than against a summary of it</li> <li>Judgment about what not to build, and the ability to say plainly why you dropped it</li> <li>A preference for being corrected over being right</li> <li>Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments</li> <li>Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview process</strong></p> <p>Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to&nbsp;finish within a week.</p> <p>The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this&nbsp;team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk&nbsp;through your reasoning, so bring it.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence=""><strong>What We Offer </strong></p> <ul> <li>A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products</li> <li>A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive</li> <li>Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity</li> <li>The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry</li> <li>Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture</li> <li>The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more</li> <li>An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain</li> </ul> <p><strong>Think you’re a good fit for this job?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. <br>And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.</p> <p><strong>Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Refer them!&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Shift delivers AI agents that transform insurers' most critical work. By combining deep industry expertise and unmatched data resources, Shift provides proven results that have earned the trust of hundreds of the world's leading insurers. Our insurance-grade AI is accurate, explainable, and secure—empowering human experts to move with unmatched speed, total confidence, and a renewed focus on the people they serve.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><video poster="https://8595762.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/8595762/2026%20Website%20Refresh/2026%20Shift%20Brand%20Video/thumbnail-violet.jpg" controls="controls" width="300" height="150"> &nbsp;&nbsp;<source src="https://8595762.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na1.net/hubfs/8595762/2026%20Website%20Refresh/2026%20Shift%20Brand%20Video/2026%20Shift%20Brand%20Video%20(English).mp4" type="video/mp4"> &nbsp;&nbsp;Your browser does not support the video tag.</video></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Our culture is built on innovation, trust, and a drive to transform the insurance industry through our SaaS platform. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Learn more at <a href="http://www.shift-technology.com" target="_blank">www.shift-technology.com</a></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p>As part of the UK Project Management team, you will be central to how Shift delivers for its clients.</p> <p>You will own complex, client-facing projects from planning through execution, bringing structure, clarity and momentum across Delivery, Data Science, Product, Engineering, GTM and customer teams.</p> <p>This role is suited to an experienced Project Manager who is already comfortable operating independently, but who also values coaching, feedback and continuous development. You will be expected to anticipate issues before they escalate, challenge ambiguity, improve how we work and bring practical ideas that strengthen delivery.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise software projects across the UK portfolio</li> <li>Build and maintain credible delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID registers, decision logs and governance rhythms</li> <li>Connect Shift’s Delivery, Data Science, Product, Engineering and GTM teams with the customer’s technical and business stakeholders</li> <li>Anticipate delivery, resource, commercial and customer risks early, then bring clear options and recommendations</li> <li>Drive actions to closure with named owners and dates, rather than relying on broad email chains or unclear follow-up</li> <li>Provide concise, fact-based reporting for customers and senior leadership</li> <li>Maintain accurate project and portfolio information across the relevant systems, including Salesforce, Jira and delivery-planning tools</li> <li>Lead customer workshops, governance meetings, Steering Committees and recovery discussions where required</li> <li>Support pre-sales and opportunity shaping by validating scope, delivery methodology, assumptions, resource needs, timelines and Statements of Work</li> <li>Challenge unsupported commitments constructively and ensure Delivery and technical assumptions are understood before plans are positioned externally</li> <li>Manage several workstreams or clients at the same time without losing control of detail, priorities or customer outcomes</li> <li>Improve delivery practices through reusable templates, smarter workflows, automation and practical use of AI</li> <li>Contribute to strategic UK and wider Delivery initiatives that make execution more predictable, repeatable and scalable</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years delivering enterprise SaaS and complex IT delivery: At least 7 years of experience delivering IT, enterprise SaaS, data, analytics, or digital transformation projects, with a strong background in complex client-facing implementations.</li> <li>Independent cross-functional operator: The ability to operate independently across Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Go-To-Market teams, making sound judgments while knowing when to escalate appropriately.</li> <li>Proactive risk management &amp; project recovery: A proactive, pre-emptive mindset to identify risks before they occur, alongside proven experience in project recovery, managing escalations, and challenging scope when needed.</li> <li>Strong ownership and execution: High personal accountability and follow-through. You do not wait to be chased.</li> <li>Concise, impactful communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to convey complex situations clearly, concisely, and actionably to senior customer stakeholders and internal leaders.</li> <li>Commercial judgment &amp; SOW management: Strong commercial awareness, including sharp commercial judgment and SOW awareness to balance scope, effort, cost, margin, and customer commitments.</li> <li>Delivery governance &amp; continuous improvement: Strong planning, governance, and risk-management skills, paired with a continuous-improvement mindset and a history of refining tools, templates, processes, or ways of working.</li> <li>Adaptable &amp; coachable collaborator: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, open to coaching and mentoring, and possess the maturity to challenge constructively while contributing original ideas.</li> <li>Modern tooling proficiency: Experience using core delivery platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, Atlassian, Asana, Monday.com, or similar PMO systems.</li> <li>Language skills: Native or full professional fluency in English.</li> <li>Industry experience: Prior experience in insurance is strongly preferred; background in fraud, data science, or other regulated industries is beneficial.</li> <li>Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or similar project management certifications are advantageous, though not essential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Good Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Risks are surfaced early, not hidden</li> <li>Customers receive clear, consistent and evidence-based updates</li> <li>Plans reflect reality and are kept current</li> <li>Actions always have an owner and a date</li> <li>Delivery, Data Science and GTM remain aligned</li> <li>Escalations come with options and recommendations</li> <li>Repetitive work becomes templated, automated or removed</li> <li>Lessons from one project improve the next</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interview Process</strong></p> <ul> <li>Talent Acquisition</li> <li>Case Study + UK Team</li> <li>Head of UK Delivery</li> <li>Global Head of Delivery</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="color: #000000;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">To support our permanent, full time employees at every stage of their careers and lives, we provide a competitive total rewards and benefits package. title: Senior Scrum Master - Core Video & Data
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/newsweek-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces-2023">Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.</p> <p>As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Coach the system, not just the team.</strong> You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.</li> <li><strong>Architect outcomes, not processes.</strong> You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.</li> <li><strong>Anticipate, not react.</strong> You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.</li> <li><strong>Foster psychological safety.</strong> You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.</li> <li><strong>Align and design for visibility.</strong> You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>An experienced Agile practitioner. </strong>You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.</li> <li><strong>A systems thinker.</strong> You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven and predictive. </strong>You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.</li> <li><strong>A clear communicator.</strong> You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.</li> <li><strong>A champion of responsible speed.</strong> You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>AI fluency.</strong> You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.</li> <li><strong>A diverse Agile toolbelt. </strong>You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Global team experience. </strong>Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Champion work-life harmony</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Guarantee autonomy</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Encourage career growth</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.</span></li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing. </strong>Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you’re located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.&nbsp;</p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£48,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£80,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Inclusion at Hudl&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.&nbsp;<br><br>We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, <a href="https://www.hudl.com/about-inclusion" target="_blank">including employee resource groups and communities</a>. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in <a href="https://www.hudl.com/about-inclusion" target="_blank">annual inclusion reports</a>.&nbsp;<br><br><span style="font-weight: 400;">We also know imposter syndrome is real and the <a href="https://www.theatlantic.com/magazine/archive/2014/05/the-confidence-gap/359815/" target="_blank">confidence gap</a> can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.</span></p> <h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
